summary: Three fractal-daemon reminder-deletion tests build a native reminder group of 1,024 members on pull requests (was 4,096); the daily run (ST_TEST_SCALE=full) keeps 4,096. Recomputing the whole group on a deletion still fails all three at the smaller size.

replay.detail: Test only; no claim, replay or projection change.

rules.detail: No rule, permission or trust change.

compatibility.detail: No wire, CLI or client change.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs differently on installed machines.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit to run the full sizes on every pull request again.
